core_result: Consolidates the four archived Pauli/Mermin contextuality repositories into one unified Apache-2.0 / CC-BY-4.0 monorepo meeting Build Standard v1.2.0 (100.0%, 68/68 checks, Core 30/30) and Playbook v1.3, closing all six Track 1/2 formal-code errata AND 100% of Track 2 Eqs. 1-16 in Lean 4.35.0. Ships a pinned Lean 4.35.0 + Mathlib v4.35.0 workspace (65 .lean files; all 9 standalone Track 1 finite-certificate modules compiled and axiom-audited live in parallel CI via VerifyStandalone.lean and VerifyPhaseSeven.lean), searchable 29-node / 213-declaration Lean Blueprint with MathJax SRI, explicit Sp(2N,2) witness isomorphism verifier & hyperbolic quasi-quadric (135/1,095/75) Qontextium exports, 4 zero-overflow Tectonic PDFs (0.00pt max overfull), 7/7 AST source-code mutation suite (100% kill rate), and 3-OS + 14-engine C11 ASan/UBSan CI (run 46055696084). Track 1 formalizes Jonah's universal and Kramers spectral floors (arbitrary supports), two-sided asymptotic 1/2 limits, five-way saturation equivalences, finite flat degrees 75, 480, 2016 and 729344 (live-audited in CI), infinite non-closed pure-CCZ family |Psi_{3m}> (m>=1, contextual m>=2), lower bounds d(W(7,2))>=1455 and d(Q+(9,2))>=6444 (below Jonah's earlier 1575/6975 claims), exact four-qubit C3 binary completion optima (368 vs 344), formal geometric vertex-case membership predicates IsCaseC1-IsCaseC15 (ConjectureECases.lean) + strict-law failure for one representative per case for all N>=4 (whole-case transfer via Jonah's Theorem B4 outside Lean), and 8 kernel-proved perturbed-bound refutations. Track 2 (ContextualityTensor/GeneralTheory.lean + ActualModel.lean + SeedSupport.lean) formalizes 100% of Eqs. 1-16: exact degrees (7^k-5^k)/2 (squares), (6^k-4^k)/2 (pentagrams), mixed (7^s 6^t - 5^s 4^t)/2 (s squares + t pentagrams), heterogeneous endpoint reduction (Theorem 2), universal general-seed asymptotics eps_k(G) -> 1 for every finite contextual signed seed (Theorem 5), arbitrary-k 2k- and 3k-qubit literal Pauli realizations (Eq. 5), kernel-decided HS(L(K_{3,3})) / HS(Petersen) support equality, and k-independent independent-readout noise thresholds with noisy score decay to 0 (Eqs. 14-16). Track 3 proves finite adaptive-tree sequential evidence bounds and a sharp Peres-Mermin setting-bias attack. All 3 parallel Lean CI jobs (run 46055695985) passed 100% green: 217 explicit + 2,452 exhaustive axioms, live tamper gate, 15-module Batteries linter, 24 targets across 6 independent kernels (SLSA #73255989), VerifyStandalone (SLSA #73261704), VerifyPhaseSeven (SLSA #73249231), and Release v3.3.0 (run 46062140725, SLSA #73263415).

Remaining outside Lean: whole-case single-orbit transitivity via Jonah's Theorem B4, finite C censuses (540.3M N=9 forms, 42-orbit W(5,2) census), Moonlab/QGTL/QRNG simulations, and exploratory floating-point scripts (100% of Track 2 Eqs. 1-16 are now kernel-proved inside Lean 4.35.0).
